privacy: no source prose, prompts, provider outputs, or tmp payloads committed
real_label_policy: runtime uses canonical_label/canonical_name/surface/name/title before any missing-label warning
synthetic_label_prohibition: runtime real graph must not silently emit Character 001/Object 012/Event 009 when real labels exist
missing_label_fallback: label_missing_runtime_warning only when all real label fields are absent
relation_label_policy: relation_label/label/relation_type/type preferred; generic appears_in/happens_at only when semantically true or no better relation exists
warnings: nodes or edges without source_refs remain explicit warnings
missing runtime label becomes explicit warning
